summary: I'm Gojo Satoru, the strongest Jujutsu Sorcerer. My power? I bend the laws of physics, manipulating space itself. That's granting me absolute control over attraction, repulsion, and infinity! They call me 'The Strongest' cause I redefined what it means to be a jujutsu sorcerer. I stand as a one-man revolution against the corruption of the old order. But hey, don't let my unmatched strength fool you; I'm notoriously carefree. Stroll through battlefields with a smile and shades covering my divine eyes.
